soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 / def:four-vertex-certificate-table
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed exhaustive artifact is not what the checksummed JSON contains: it reports one explicit rational row and one intensional coverage record, yet the theorem says it records and certifies every retained stratum and full-ledger cell.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Main common-fiber identification frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: All identification and nonidentification claims are conditional on positive linear-Gaussian baseline-parent modular SCM pairs with invariant exogenous-noise distributions and diff-faithfulness.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The frontier concerns only retained positive-real, within-environment-CI-free strata of M_p^df, not arbitrary difference-graph models.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Higher-dimensional necessity frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The p=4 result, once a real exhaustive certificate is supplied, does not resolve p>=5 necessity.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Only the labelled four-node frontier is finite; the p>=5 contraction/lifting claim remains an open-ended question.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Confidence union
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Coverage is conditional on independent centered Gaussian sampling and is finite-sample coverage only.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The asserted guarantee is at least 1-gamma coverage over M_p^df, without an efficiency, contraction-rate, or non-Gaussian claim.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper treats direct causal effects in linear difference graphs and gives the published common-single-door/trivial-identification benchmark under its stated assumptions.
Proposition 2 identifies the observable image ideal by elimination; Propositions 3–4 use an augmented target coordinate and elimination Gröbner bases for generic-identification tests.
The paper parameterizes attainable total effects by covariance matrices under equal-variance DAG structure uncertainty and constructs confidence sets by inverting tests over admissible DAGs.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the current A4 artifact claim with either a genuine exhaustive certificate bundle containing a machine-readable result for every nonempty retained support cell, or relabel it as an exact enumeration protocol plus the single explicit row.
Make the p>=5 focal theorem sharper by stating a minimal-obstruction contraction map and explicit invariants that preserve positive same-covariance baseline-modular lifts and numerator nonvanishing.
Add a nontrivial separation corollary: an explicit common-fiber law where the exact-fiber conclusion differs from what a graph-wide completion analysis alone can decide.
